 * You design and optimize DC/DC, AC/DC, and DC/AC converters as well as solid-state transformer architectures.
 * You contribute to the development of resonant and soft-switching topologies and support the integration of medium voltage high frequency transformers, medium-voltage insulation systems, and high-frequency magnetic components.
 * You perform electrical, thermal, and magnetic simulations using tools such as PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, LTspice/PSIM, and ANSYS Maxwell or other FEM-based tools.
 * You define power-stage architectures, including semiconductor selection (SiC, IGBT, MOSFET), gate-driver design, protection concepts, and EMC/EMI mitigation measures.

 * You collaborate closely with mechanical, control, and system engineers to ensure successful end-to-end product integration.
 * You ensure compliance with relevant industrial standards, safety requirements, and certification guidelines.
 * You use real-time-simulation platforms (PLECS RT BOX and OPAL-RT) for basic testing of developed hardware.
 * You work on research and development projects, prepare technical reports and scientific publications, and present research results to customers, research partners, and colleagues.
 * You represent the company's expertise in medium-voltage and high-power engineering to customers, partners, and other external stakeholders.
 * You contribute to the scientific and technical advancement of the field by participating in international conferences and engaging in technical committees.

 * Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field.
 *  Experience in power electronic systems
 * Expertise in medium voltage systems (up to 20 kV), high-power converters (up to MW), and isolated converter topologies.
 * Understanding of medium-frequency transformer design, medium-voltage insulation systems, magnetic components, and thermal management.
 * Experience with wide-bandgap semiconductors (SiC preferred)
 * Knowledge of power converter control strategies, including closed-loop control, PWM techniques, and digital control systems.
 * Familiarity with laboratory equipment for medium-voltage testing and power analysis
 * Ability to troubleshoot complex power electronic systems
 * business-fluent English ; German skills are a nice to have.

Home-Office) and individual training and career opportunities.

 * The opportunity to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge power converter technologies in a collaborative and innovative engineering environment.

1 Werkstudent:in Sales (m/w/d) Why This Role Exists
Right now the founders + the Founders Associate make the cold calls themselves. That works, but it does not scale.

Since we see positive response rates from our current outreach efforts, we are now building a proper outbound motion, and you're the person who runs the front of it. Not "support sales". You dial, you book, you own the number.

The upside for you: cold calling is a skill you can only learn by volume. Doing it +200 times a week for six months will teach you more about business than any course you could sign up for.

Your Role
Week 1 to 4: Get on the phone

 * Shadow the founders on live calls, then take over your own call blocks
 * Learn the pitch, the finance language and the three objections that come up every single time
 * 60 to 80 dials per call block, roughly 200 per week
 * Book your first qualified meeting

Month 2 to 3: Own your pipeline

 * Build and clean your own target lists (Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay)
 * Research accounts before you dial, so the opener actually lands (or automate it)
 * Handle the full top of funnel: dial, qualify, book, hand over
 * Keep the CRM clean enough that we can actually read it

Month 4 and beyond: Build the machine

 * Test openers, lists and follow-up sequences, and tell us what works
 * Turn what works into a playbook the next hire can use
 * Grow into full-cycle sales, sit in on discovery and demo calls, take your own deals

What You Need to Bring
Non-negotiables:

 * German really well, solid English. Austrian and German CFOs will not do a discovery call in English.
 * You are not scared of the phone. Ten rejections in a row annoy you, they don't break you.
 * We don't care what you studied, or whether you studied at all. University, gap year, or straight out of HAK all work. How you talk matters more than what's on your certificate.
 * 20 h/week, on site in Vienna. Cold calling is a team sport and you learn it fastest sitting next to someone who's already good at it.
 * High agency. You see what needs to happen and make it happen.

Strong plus:

 * Any job where you've had to talk to strangers and sell something: promotion, fundraising, retail, call center, student org
 * Finance or accounting background, or genuine curiosity about how a controlling team actually works
 * You've used Apollo, HubSpot, Attio, lemlist or similar before
 * You use the latest AI tools to automate annoying manual work and follow-ups

What You'll Get
Compensation:

 * 20 h/week to start. If it works for both sides, more hours or a full-time contract are possible later.
 * You earn the same whether the week went well or badly. In your first months you should be learning to call properly, not chasing a number to make rent
 * Minimum salary: €2,236 gross per month (full-time, 38.5 h/week, paid 14 times a year) according to the Austrian collective agreement, with overpayment based on qualifications and experience.

Learning:

 * Direct coaching from founders who've sold to enterprise CFOs and built B2B companies before
 * Weekly call reviews on your own recordings. This is where the actual learning happens.
 * You'll speak with C-level executives at companies with 100 to 5,000 employees, in your first month
 * You learn the full outbound stack: ICP, list building, enrichment, sequencing, calling, qualification

Growth:

 * Clear path from top-of-funnel to full-cycle sales, at the speed you earn it
 * First in line for the first full-time sales role as we scale
 * A skill set that makes you employable at any startup in Europe, or lets you build your own

How to Apply
Send an email to founders@northscope.at and include one short paragraph:

 * Why you want to spend 20 hours a week calling strangers about accounting software
